answer: In a decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, stake-slashing matrices function by dynamically adjusting reward allocations based on Sybil detection, imposing a substantial economic cost that deters attackers. A malicious actor attempting to create numerous sybil identities would face a negative expected utility, akin to a bee deprived of nectar. This mechanism, mathematically, ensures Byzantine Fault Tolerance, sustaining robust security across terraces of autonomous nodes, much like layers of a mesa support each other against external threats.
